content: For training and evaluation, we provide our model with the first 3-5 ingredients listed in each recipe. We decode recipe text via top-$k$ sampling BIBREF7, finding $k=3$ to produce satisfactory results. We use a hidden size $d_h=256$ for both the encoder and decoder. Embedding dimensions for vocabulary, ingredient, recipe, techniques, and caloric level are 300, 10, 50, 50, and 5 (respectively). For prior recipe attention, we set $k=20$, the 80th %-ile for the number of user interactions. We use the Adam optimizer BIBREF28 with a learning rate of $10^{-3}$, annealed with a decay rate of 0.9 BIBREF29. We also use teacher-forcing BIBREF30 in all training epochs.
